title: Observe screen, first web version (spike)
summary: The first screen of the new web UI, live on the Seestar S50 simulator through the headless server (API v1): WebGL viewer with the portrait frame shown landscape, levels strip with a draggable histogram, Camera and Mount cards, mount state in the status bar, the three themes and the error and offline states.

shots.caption: Observe, live view, Observatory theme at 1440x900: the rotated frame fills the viewer, the levels strip uses the space under it.
Observe, live view, Charcoal theme at 1440x900.
Observe, live view, Night Red theme: the image is rendered red only for dark adaptation.
Observe at 1280x800, the smallest reference screen.
Right panel closed (P): the image takes the full width.
Fill mode (Shift+F) with the right panel closed: the frame fills the viewer, a chip says it is cropped.
Black, midtones and white handles dragged directly on the histogram's ADU axis.
Exposure changed during live view: the new value applies from the next frame and the pending change is shown.
Mount slewing: remaining angle and Abort in the status bar.
Disconnecting during live view or a slew asks for confirmation.
After a disconnection the last frame is marked as stale, never shown as live.
Server offline: devices read 'No link', readouts grey out, the viewer says so.
Connection form with an invalid port: inline validation, connect refused.
Log drawer open over the Observe screen.
Connection chip in the toolbar revealing the Connection card.
